_comment_github: Git pushes must not deploy this site, and that is not a preference.
The installers live in release/, which .gitignore excludes because they are
~5MB each and are what took .git to 2.66GB. .vercelignore deliberately does
NOT exclude them, so a CLI deploy from a machine that has just built them
uploads them and copy-web-assets.mjs puts them in dist/downloads.
A build from GitHub has no release/*.dmg and cannot have one. So every
git-triggered deploy either fails or publishes a site whose Download button
404s, and a push of an unrelated copy change silently replaces a working
deploy with a broken one. That is exactly what happened after 0.9.8: the
release deployed and verified 200, three pushes later the DMG was a 404 and
So the only thing that publishes is scripts/release.sh. If the site should
ever deploy from git again, downloads have to stop being built artifacts
first: point VITE_RELEASE_BASE at GitHub Releases, which copy-web-assets.mjs
already supports, and then turn this back on.
